query_text: Buy a return train ticket from Boston to New York for next Friday

To buy a return train ticket from Boston to New York for next Friday, here are some options you can use:

1. **Amtrak (Official)** – The most direct way to book:
   - 🌐 Visit [amtrak.com](https://www.amtrak.com)
   - 📱 Or use the **Amtrak app** (available on iOS & Android)
   - 📞 Or call **1-800-872-7245**

2. **Third-Party Booking Sites** – These may offer price comparisons:
   - [Rome2Rio](https://www.rome2rio.com)
   - [Trainline](https://www.thetrainline.com)
   - [Kayak](https://www.kayak.com)

3. **Tips for Your Journey:**
   - 🚆 Amtrak operates several services on this route, including the **Acela** (high-speed) and the **Northeast Regional** (more affordable).
   - ⏱️ Travel time is roughly **3.5 to 4.5 hours** depending on the service.
   - 💰 Book early for the best prices, especially for Friday travel.
   - 🎫 Make sure to select a **round trip** when searching to get your return ticket.
